SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Aabb
An Aabb (Axis-Aligned Bounding Box) is a rectangle aligned with the coordinate axes, used for collision detection.
ArenaCycle
An arena cycle consists of waves with breaks between them, ending in a boss wave followed by a shop, and tracks the number of waves defeated as the score.
ArenaCycle.Phase
The current phase of the arena cycle.
Armor
An armor the player wears in its portrait slot (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4): it adds its defense bonus to the build of its holder.
AroundContactAttack
A contact attack that hits all around the owner (GDD 1.3.1): its area is the owner's body box grown by the reach on every side, as an Obb at angle 0 (DECISIONS §5).
Arrow
The shot of a bow: the Archer's and the Skeleton Archer's (GDD 1.3.1).
Assassin
The fast, fragile class (GDD 1.2): less HP than the knight, more speed and attack speed (Q15).
Attack
What a character's attack does (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6).
AttackDecorator
Base of every attack wrapper that a passive item adds (GDD 1.3.1).
AttackStarted
A character starts an attack: a swing, a shot or a bite (GDD 1.3.1).
Axe
The axe: a slow, heavy melee weapon whose blade sweeps a wide arc (GDD 1.6).
BaseStats
A character's stats before any item, read from its class or enemy data (GDD 1.6, Q93).
Bow
The bow family: every bow shoots an Arrow from the centre of its owner (GDD 1.3.1).
BuildModifier
Something that changes a character's build while it is held: equipment (weapon, armor) and passive items (GDD 1.3.1).
Burn
A burn (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6): damage over time from fire, such as the fire ring's.
Character
Base class for player and enemy entities, with shared health and damage handling.
CharacterBuild
What a character fights with right now (GDD 1.3.1): its attack and its stats, after its equipment and passive items.
CharacterFactory
Builds every character of data/characters.json from its id (Q23, Q129).
CharacterKind
The class an entry of data/characters.json builds, read from its "class" field (Q23): a kind of one family, enemy or player.
CharacterSpec
The values every character type shares, read from data/characters.json (Q93).
CharacterSpecReader
Reads one entry of data/characters.json into a CharacterSpec (Q23, Q129).
Collidable
Something with a body that other bodies can touch (GDD 1.5).
Consumable
An item used once from the hotbar, such as a potion (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4).
ContactAttack
The attack of an enemy that hits at contact, such as a rat or a zombie (GDD 1.3.1): every hostile character whose hurtbox touches its area gets hit.
Damageable
Represents an object that can take damage and have a hurtbox.
DamageDealt
A character hit another one.
DamageFormula
Computes damage per hit using the formula in GDD 1.6, Q26: damage = max(1, ((attack + attackBonus) x attackBuff) / ((resistance + resistanceBonus) x resistanceBuff)), rounded down.
DamageOverTime
Damage over time (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6): deals its damage at the end of every interval until its duration is over.
DataRegistry
The entries of one JSON data file, by id (Q129).
DebugFeature
One engine showcase feature (rewind, view switcher, event laser, editor); see GDD 1.1.2.
DotSpec
The values of a burn, read from data/items.json (Q93), all counted in logic ticks (60 per second).
Enemy
Every enemy and boss (GDD 1.3.1).
EnemyFactory
Builds the enemies of data/characters.json for the CharacterFactory (Q23, Q129).
EnemyKind
The enemy kinds of data/characters.json, built by the EnemyFactory.
EnemySetup
What every enemy is built from, whatever its family: the values of its data/characters.json entry that all enemies share, plus where it lives.
EnemySpawner
Puts one enemy in the world for the WaveDirector.
EnemyState
What an enemy is doing (GDD 1.3 roster, 1.7).
Entity
Anything that lives in the world and is updated once per logic tick (GDD 1.3.1).
EntityDied
A character died (GDD 1.1.2, F2 shows it): the renderer plays its death, the sound plays, the loot may drop.
Equipment
An item the player equips in a portrait slot: a weapon or an armor (GDD 1.3.1, 2.2).
Evade
The two quick moves of the player (GDD 2.4, Q40): a move in a fixed direction for a few ticks, then a cooldown that starts once it is over.
EventBus
Carries game events from emitters to listeners, so that neither holds a reference to the other (GDD 1.1.2).
EventLaser
The F2 debug feature (GDD 1.1.2): turns every event on the bus into a short-lived line from its emitter to its receiver, so the decoupled objects can be seen talking.
EventLaser.Line
One line on screen, fixed where the event happened.
EventListener
Receives game events from an EventBus.
Execute
Finishes a target that a landed hit leaves under a part of its max HP (GDD 1.3.1).
ExecutionerRing
A passive item whose hits finish targets left under a part of their max HP (GDD 1.3.1).
Faction
The side a character fights for (GDD 1.5).
Fireball
The shot of the Dark Mage (GDD 1.3.1): it burns the first character it hurts, then stops.
FireRing
A passive item that makes every landed hit of its holder burn the target (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4.1).
FireStaff
The fire staff: a Mage's staff that casts a Fireball from the centre of its owner (GDD 1.3.1).
FireTouch
Adds a burn to every hit of the wrapped attack that lands (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4.1): a hit that deals no damage, on a dead or invincible target, burns nothing.
FixedTimestep
Turns variable frame times into a whole number of fixed logic ticks (Q42).
FloorPlan
What an Endless floor holds (Q47, Q17): the deeper the floor, the more enemies, of more kinds, with better stats, and one king on the stele.
FloorSequence
Which Tiled map each floor of an Endless run is played on (Q77).
FrontContactAttack
A contact attack that hits in front of the owner, towards the aim (GDD 1.3.1): its area starts at the centre of the body and goes as far as the reach past the body's edge, whatever the angle.
GameConstants
Fixed, non-gameplay constants.
GameEvent
Something that happened in the game.
Hitbox
The area of an attack that deals damage (GDD 1.5): a melee swing, a projectile, a trap or a contact attack.
HitResult
What one hit did (GDD 1.6): the damage it dealt and whether it killed the target.
HotReload
The F5 debug feature: reads the data files again while the game runs (GDD 1.1.2).
Interactable
What the interact key (E) uses when no item lies in reach (GDD 2.4): the shopkeeper, later the chests and the locked doors.
Inventory
The player's bag (GDD 1.4): 3 hotbar slots that take only consumables, 18 slots that take only passive items, the equipped weapon and the worn armor.
Item
Base type of everything the player can carry: weapons, armor, consumables and passive items (GDD 1.3.1).
ItemDrop
An item lying on the ground (GDD 1.4): dropped by a monster or by the player, or placed in a room.
ItemDropped
An item falls on the ground (GDD 1.4): the player left it (a swapped weapon, a full bag, the Drop button) or a monster dropped it.
ItemDropper
Puts items on the ground (GDD 1.4): the one entry point for an item appearing in the world.
ItemEffect
One line of what an item gives (GDD 1.4), shown when the item is selected in the inventory: a translation key and its value, e.g.
ItemFactory
Builds items from data/items.json (Q23, Q129).
ItemPickedUp
A character takes an item off the ground and keeps it (GDD 1.4).
ItemSpec
The values of one entry of data/items.json (Q93, Q129), typed by its "class".
ItemSpec.AxeSpec
An "Axe" entry; same values as a sword.
ItemSpec.ExecutionerRingSpec
An "ExecutionerRing" entry.
ItemSpec.FireRingSpec
A "FireRing" entry.
ItemSpec.FireStaffSpec
A "FireStaff" entry: a bow's values and the burn of its fireball.
ItemSpec.LeatherArmorSpec
A "LeatherArmor" entry.
ItemSpec.LifeStealRingSpec
A "LifeStealRing" entry.
ItemSpec.PlainBowSpec
A "PlainBow" entry: a bow that shoots plain arrows.
ItemSpec.PotionSpec
A "Potion" entry.
ItemSpec.ShieldSpec
A "Shield" entry.
ItemSpec.StatRingSpec
A "StatRing" entry.
ItemSpec.SwordSpec
A "Sword" entry.
ItemSpecReader
Reads one entry of data/items.json into an ItemSpec (Q93, Q129).
Knight
The melee class (GDD 1.2).
LeatherArmor
A leather armor (GDD 1.4).
LifeSteal
Heals the attacker by a part of the damage of every hit that lands (GDD 1.3.1).
LifeStealRing
A passive item that heals its holder by a part of the damage it deals (GDD 1.3.1).
LootDrops
Drops an item of the loot table where an enemy dies (GDD 1.4); the table makes rare items drop less often.
LootTable
Picks the item a dead enemy drops (GDD 1.4): first a rarity, by its share of the drops, then one entry of data/items.json of that rarity, each with the same chance.
MeleeEnemy
The enemies that hit at contact: Rat, Zombie, Orc (GDD 1.3.1).
MeleeWeapon
A weapon that hits up close with a blade (GDD 1.6).
Obb
An Obb (Oriented Bounding Box) is a rectangle that can turn: a melee swing's hitbox pointing towards the aim (GDD 1.5).
PassiveItem
A permanent modifier the player holds, such as the fire ring (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4).
PlainBow
A bow with no special effect (GDD 1.3.1): it shoots a plain arrow.
Player
The character the user controls (GDD 1.3.1).
PlayerFactory
Builds the players of data/characters.json for the CharacterFactory (Q23, Q129).
PlayerInput
What the user asks the player to do, whatever the device (keyboard, gamepad, a scripted fake in tests).
PlayerKind
The player kinds (classes, GDD 1.2) of data/characters.json.
PlayerOrders
What the user asks the player to do right now (Q38): a direction to walk in and a point to attack towards.
Poison
A poison (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6): damage over time from venom.
Potion
A consumable that restores HP to the character who drinks it (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4).
Projectile
A shot that flies straight until a wall stops it or its lifetime ends: an arrow, a fireball (GDD 1.3.1).
RandomSource
Source of randomness injected everywhere, so the same seed gives the same run (Q114).
RangedWeapon
A weapon that attacks from afar: each attack fires one projectile that flies Weapon.getRange() pixels (GDD 1.3.1).
Rarity
How rare an item is (GDD 1.3.1).
Rat
The rat (fast, weak; bites at contact; GDD 1.3).
RatNest
The rat nest (GDD 1.3): a static summoner that spawns rats while it sees its target.
Reloadable
Something F5 can read again from its data file while the game runs (GDD 1.1.2): a DataRegistry, or a factory that hands its values to live entities.
Rewind
The R debug feature: holding R plays the last seconds backwards, like a video (GDD 1.1.2).
Rewindable
Something the R rewind can save and put back (GDD 1.1.2): it writes its own state into a StateBuffer and reads it back, so no other class sees its private fields.
RewindGroup
Several Rewindable saved as one photo (GDD 1.1.2, R): the world and what runs beside it, such as the Arena cycle and its wave director.
SeededRandomSource
Deterministic RandomSource: the same seed always replays the same sequence.
Shield
A shield worn in the armor slot (GDD 1.4).
Shopkeeper
The shopkeeper, the only NPC (GDD 1.3, 1.4).
ShopOpened
A player talked to the shopkeeper while he trades (GDD 1.4): the shop page opens on it.
Staff
The staff family: a mage's weapon that casts a spell projectile (GDD 1.3.1).
Stat
The stats shared by the player and the enemies (GDD 1.6, Q44, Q45).
StateBuffer
One photo of the game for the R rewind (GDD 1.1.2, Q86): every Rewindable writes its values here one after another, then reads them back in the same order to go back to that moment.
StatRing
A passive item that adds a flat amount to one stat of its holder (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4).
StatSource
Gives a value to each Stat.
StatusEffect
An effect that lasts a number of ticks on a character, such as a burn (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6).
Summoner
Builds the enemies a summoner spawns (GDD 1.3.1: "summon through the EnemyFactory").
Swing
One melee attack in progress (GDD 1.6): the blade of a MeleeWeapon sweeps its arc around the holder, one step per tick, and hits each enemy it touches once.
Sword
The sword: the Knight's melee weapon (GDD 1.2, 1.6).
TeleportZone
The teleport zone to the next floor (GDD 1.1 step 3, Q11).
Updatable
Something the worl update by logic tick.
ViewMode
The views the F1 switcher loops through (GDD 1.1.2).
ViewSwitcher
The F1 debug feature: picks which view the screen draws (GDD 1.1.2).
Wall
A solid tile of the map (GDD 1.5).
WaveDirector
Runs the Arena loop on top of an ArenaCycle: spawns each wave when it starts, tells the cycle when the wave is cleared, and lets the fixed break run between two waves.
WavePlan
Says which enemies a wave holds (GDD 1.1, Arena mode).
Weapon
The equipped weapon: the player's attack (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6).
World
Holds everything alive during one run and advances it, one logic tick at a time.
Zombie
The zombie (slow, sturdy; hits at contact; GDD 1.3).
